edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key in transfer and transferFrom flows.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of the allowed mapping in approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Caller address supplies the balances key for the transfer of tokens.
Caller address supplies the spender key of allowed inside transferFrom.
Caller address is the owner key written by approve.
Caller address is forwarded as the from argument of the receiveApproval callback.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Owned constructor derives privileged owner from msg.sender.
Caller controlled spender address and msg.sender argument reach the external receiveApproval call.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance stored in allowed.
transfer calls safeSub to decrement the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to increment the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer performs balance addition and subtraction arithmetic.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic.
safeSub guards the subtraction arithmetic used by the token transfers.
safeAdd guards the addition arithmetic used by the token transfers.
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call before returning success.
The external callback can re-enter the contract and mutate the allowed allowance state.
The external callback can re-enter transferFrom and move token balances.
The spender contract can call back into transferFrom during receiveApproval.
The spender contract can call back into transfer during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an unrestricted external call to the supplied token contract after the onlyOwner gate.
The stored owner address is used as the recipient of the recovered ERC20 tokens.
transferOwnership writes the caller supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender.
Parameter to is the recipient in transfer.
Parameter to is the recipient in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the approved amount in approve.
Parameter tokens is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded in transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount is passed as an argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter spender is the approved spender in approve.
Parameter spender is both approved and called in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is the payload accepted by approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the target contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
Caller supplied tokenAddress becomes the receiver of the external transfer call.
Parameter _newOwner is staged as the pending owner.
Parameter tokenOwner keys the balances lookup in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner keys the allowed lookup in allowance.
Local balance is the return slot of balanceOf.
Local remaining is the return slot of allowance.
safeAdd assigns the result to local c.
safeSub assigns the result to local c.
safeMul assigns the result to local c.
safeDiv assigns the result to local c.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply adjusted by the burn address balance.
Leaf constructor writes the minted _totalSupply value.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] before returning.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry.
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry.
The reverting fallback prevents ether based arithmetic or reentrancy triggers on the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to only carries call data into transfer, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
Parameter tokens is the primary transfer amount argument and folds into the transfer function node.
Parameter from is only meaningful inside transferFrom and merges into it.
Parameter spender is approved and then called, so it merges into approveAndCall.
Parameter data is only consumed by approveAndCall and merges into that function node.
Parameter tokenAddress is the external target of transferAnyERC20Token and merges into it.
Parameter _newOwner only feeds the transferOwnership state write and merges into it.
Parameter tokenOwner is the lookup key for allowance and merges into that view function.
Local balance is the return placeholder of balanceOf and merges into that function.
Local remaining is the return placeholder of allowance and merges into that function.
Local c is produced by the SafeMath helpers and merges into safeAdd as their representative computation node.
